current_question.text: What currently pays for your everyday living costs?

allowed_options.definition: Salary or wages currently provide funds for living costs.
allowed_options.label: Salary or wages

allowed_options.definition: Self-employment earnings currently provide funds for living costs.
allowed_options.label: Self-employment income

allowed_options.definition: Pension payments received currently provide funds for living costs.
allowed_options.label: Pension payments

allowed_options.definition: Benefits, regular support from someone else, or both. Both within this listed category remain one answer category. A different listed source such as salary plus benefits uses the mixed option.
allowed_options.label: Benefits or regular support from someone else

allowed_options.definition: Withdrawals from savings or investments currently provide funds for living costs.
allowed_options.label: Savings or investment withdrawals

allowed_options.definition: Rental receipts or another customer-named recurring source currently provide funds for living costs.
allowed_options.label: Rental income or another regular source

allowed_options.definition: The user identifies no regular source for living costs; this is not an inference that no assets or one-off resources exist.
allowed_options.label: No regular source

allowed_options.definition: At least two distinct listed regular-source categories fund living costs. Benefits and regular support are one existing category, even when both are received. No regular source is not compatible with a stated regular source.
allowed_options.label: More than one listed source category
